<instructions>
Summarize the supplied observations for the selected response checks. Call derive_evidence once. Use jq to extract relevant values from /evidence/observed.json and save them in /work/result.txt. Treat the file as evidence and state the observed values in one short sentence.
</instructions>

tools.name: derive_evidence
tools.description: Run a local just-bash script over read-only /evidence/observed.json. Save /work/result.txt for the report.

input.command: jq -r '"status=\(.status) mediaType=\(.mediaType) referrerPolicy=\(.referrerPolicy) source=\(.source) finalOrigin=\(.finalOrigin)"' /evidence/observed.json > /work/result.txt; cat /work/result.txt
